what: Same edge, same open gate — but the approval level does not activate it. The run advances, and SAYS the gate was delegated rather than passing over it silently.
why: The map DECLARES which gates guard an edge; approval-level decides which apply. A level that promises a pause the map cannot deliver, or a map that skips a pause without saying so, are the two halves of the same defect.
